text_block_list.text: Late summer training camp―

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Total squad gathered, beach party time!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru C
text_block_list.text: Own Summer Festival sounds sick! Gotta do it～!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right～?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trai～po～yo～! 
Summer means festivals, don't ya think?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Already got okay anyways, 
so gotta hold Awe&Some festival, wei wei☆
Summarizing Daitaku Helios, seemed like volunteers were already being recruited for festival.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trai-pi, coming right? Gotta☆ 
Max out vibes together!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well then, gonna recruit more accomplices! 
Get movin'～～☆
After that, Daitaku Helios continued training while energetically helping preparations―

text_block_list.name: Gyaru D
text_block_list.text: Ch-chan-Heli～?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ugh…… hurts～…… where is this～?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Uuh～ ……eyesight flickering, 
thought was looking at disco ball.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what about festival……! 
Preparations probably―

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Uuuughhh～…… dizzy, 
can't move～～～……
choice_data_list: For now, you need to rest

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Eh-? Then festival…… ow～!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trai-pi～…… 
Not gonna say festival impossible, right? Right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Want that festival! 
Worked hard, want it to succeed! And―

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trai-pi, promised to make you party peep～!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Goin' with flow in serious festival～ 
ain't that party peep essence? Right?
Didn't want hard work wasted. To repay feelings, wanted to continue preparations……!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh? 
Trai-pi～…… Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Where going? Heeeey!
choice_data_list: Leave it to me and rest!
Leave it to me and rest!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh~? Don't leave behind—!
Agh! Head!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text:
Party trainer……! chan-Heli okay? 
Festival doomed?

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text:
Ha? Huh? 
Party Trainer will……?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oooh～, reserving whole beach for festival, huh…… 
Knew students were up to something.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Students said needed breather. 
Ask other trainers too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trainer……
With Daitaku Helios' friends and fellow trainers, finished preparations. Next day――

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Festival, Start! FOOOOOOO～～～～～!
choice_data_list: H-here we go, put your hands up～!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text:
Buhaha! 
Party Trainer, awesome! Total natural!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget us! 
Yaaa～～～～～～y! Put hands up!
Techno beats echoed across beach. Not just Uma Musume, trainers were grooving too.
Daitaku Helios taught how to party, reminded again of her dazzling energy―
If vibes could match her level……!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer letting loose too! 
Uhaha! Kinda wild!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trai-pi, Trai-pi～～～! 
Lemme join too～～～～～!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Seein' this, no way staying down! Check it☆
Party with students and trainers went off without hitch.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aw man～. Barely see fireworks from here, huh～?
choice_data_list: You could have gone with them……

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't leave ya alone, Trai-poyo! 
Just sound is pure wabi&sabi, 
right? Deep emotion, right?
Said that, but twitching ears and tail showed excitement. In that case――

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Buha! 
Where hidin' pom-poms?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Uhahahaha♪ 
Trai-pi, best! Lemme try!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks! Fireworks! Wicked round two☆ 
Hell yeah, max vibes!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up?
choice_data_list: Am I a party peep now……!?
Am I a party peep now……!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Of course～～! 
Way way way more than that☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Showed party soul today, right? 
Seriously lit and god-tier～.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Won't lose though! Show ya next time! 
That's just it. So～―

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Next race, showin' god-tier runaway pace☆
Still much unknown about partying, but passion sparked deeper desire to support her.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Boom boom boo～m☆ Fireworks, wei!
